repairs.before: That year, Emperor Cheng sent attendants Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others bearing credentials to appoint Huang General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, Great Shanyu, Duke of Liaodong; bearer of credentials, overall commander, investiture by mandate on the model of Hui’s precedent.
repairs.after: That year, Emperor Cheng sent the yezhe Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others bearing credentials to appoint Huang General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, Great Shanyu, and Duke of Liaodong; with credentials, overall command, and authority to make appointments under imperial mandate, just as in Hui’s precedent.
repairs.sourceQuote: 是歲，成帝遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節拜皝鎮軍大將軍、平州刺史、大單于、遼東公，持節、都督、承制封拜，一如廆故事。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: That year Emperor Cheng invested him as general who guards the army, governor of Pingzhou, great shanyu, and duke of Liaodong, with full authority to enfeoff subordinates as Hui had held.
repairs.reason: 謁者 is rendered as the office yezhe, restoring 遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節 and the three grants 持節、都督、承制封拜 with 一如廆故事; all offices and names preserved.

repairs.before: That year Emperor Cheng invested him as general who guards the army, governor of Pingzhou, great shanyu, and duke of Liaodong, with full authority to enfeoff subordinates as Hui had held.
repairs.after: That year Emperor Cheng sent the envoys Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others with credentials to invest Huang as General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, great shanyu, and duke of Liaodong, with credentials, overall command, and authority to enfeoff by mandate, as Hui had held.
repairs.sourceQuote: 是歲，成帝遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節拜皝鎮軍大將軍、平州刺史、大單于、遼東公，持節、都督、承制封拜，一如廆故事。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: That year, Emperor Cheng sent attendants Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others bearing credentials to appoint Huang General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, Great Shanyu, Duke of Liaodong; bearer of credentials, overall commander, investiture by mandate on the model of Hui’s precedent.
repairs.reason: Restores 遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節 and lists 持節、都督、承制封拜 separately; offices 鎮軍將軍、平州刺史、大單于、遼東公 all kept, consistent with literal.

repairs.before: Thereupon executed Ren’s placed guardians and magistrates, divided and moved great clans of Liaodong to Jicheng, established the three counties of Heyang, Wuci, and Xile, and returned.
repairs.after: Thereupon he executed the guardians and magistrates Ren had installed, moved the great clans of Liaodong in groups to Jicheng, established the three counties of Heyang, Wuci, and Xile, and returned.
repairs.sourceQuote: 於是斬仁所置守宰，分徙遼東大姓於棘城，置和陽、武次、西樂三縣而歸。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: He executed Ren’s officials, relocated the leading Liaodong families to Jicheng, set up three new counties, and marched home.
repairs.reason: Adds the subject for 斬 and renders 仁所置守宰 and 分徙遼東大姓於棘城 accurately; the three counties 和陽、武次、西樂 retained.

repairs.before: He executed Ren’s officials, relocated the leading Liaodong families to Jicheng, set up three new counties, and marched home.
repairs.after: He executed Ren’s officials, relocated the leading Liaodong families to Jicheng, established the three counties of Heyang, Wuci, and Xile, and marched home.
repairs.sourceQuote: 於是斬仁所置守宰，分徙遼東大姓於棘城，置和陽、武次、西樂三縣而歸。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Thereupon executed Ren’s placed guardians and magistrates, divided and moved great clans of Liaodong to Jicheng, established the three counties of Heyang, Wuci, and Xile, and returned.
repairs.reason: Restores the omitted county names 和陽、武次、西樂 from 置和陽、武次、西樂三縣而歸, matching the literal field.

repairs.before: He named Feng Yi chancellor, Han Shou marshal, and distributed ministerial and command posts among Pei Kai, Yang Wu, and the rest.
repairs.after: He named Feng Yi state chancellor and Han Shou marshal, and appointed Pei Kai, Yang Wu, Wang Yu, Li Hong, Du Qun, Song Gai, Liu Zhan, Shi Cong, Huangfu Zhen, Yang Xie, Song Huang, Ping Xi, Zhang Hong and others as ministers and generals.
repairs.sourceQuote: 以封弈為國相，韓壽為司馬，裴開、陽騖、王寓、李洪、杜群、宋該、劉瞻、石琮、皇甫真、陽協、宋晃、平熙、張泓等並為列卿將帥。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Made Feng Yi state chancellor, Han Shou marshal, Pei Kai, Yang Wu, Wang Yu, Li Hong, Du Qun, Song Gai, Liu Zhan, Shi Cong, Huangfu Zhen, Yang Xie, Song Huang, Ping Xi, Zhang Hong and others concurrently ministers and generals.
repairs.reason: Restores all thirteen names in 裴開…張泓等並為列卿將帥 and 國相 as state chancellor, matching the literal list exactly.

repairs.before: Jilong sent his general Ma Qiu leading host to welcome Liao; Ke ambushed seven thousand picked cavalry at Miyun Mountain, greatly defeated them, captured their marshal Yang Yu, general Xianyu Liang, and led Duan Liao and his division host back.
repairs.after: Jilong sent his general Ma Qiu leading a host to meet Liao; Ke stationed seven thousand picked cavalry in ambush at Miyun Mountain and greatly defeated them, captured their marshal Yang Yu and general Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao and his followers back.
repairs.sourceQuote: 季龍遣其將麻秋率眾迎遼，恪伏精騎七千於密雲山，大敗之，獲其司馬陽裕、將軍鮮于亮，擁段遼及其部眾以歸。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Shi Hu sent Ma Qiu to fetch him; Murong Ke ambushed seven thousand elite riders at Miyun, captured Yang Yu and Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao in.
repairs.reason: 恪伏精騎七千於密雲山 means Ke placed his own cavalry in ambush; keeps 大敗之, 司馬陽裕, 將軍鮮于亮 and 及其部眾.

repairs.before: Shi Hu sent Ma Qiu to fetch him; Murong Ke ambushed seven thousand elite riders at Miyun, captured Yang Yu and Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao in.
repairs.after: Shi Hu sent his general Ma Qiu with troops to meet Duan Liao. Murong Ke stationed seven thousand elite cavalry in ambush at Miyun Mountain and routed them, captured marshal Yang Yu and general Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao and his followers back.
repairs.sourceQuote: 季龍遣其將麻秋率眾迎遼，恪伏精騎七千於密雲山，大敗之，獲其司馬陽裕、將軍鮮于亮，擁段遼及其部眾以歸。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Jilong sent his general Ma Qiu leading host to welcome Liao; Ke ambushed seven thousand picked cavalry at Miyun Mountain, greatly defeated them, captured their marshal Yang Yu, general Xianyu Liang, and led Duan Liao and his division host back.
repairs.reason: Restores 率眾, 大敗之, the roles 司馬/將軍, and 及其部眾, and correctly attributes the ambush 伏精騎七千 to Murong Ke.

repairs.before: Although Huang styled King of Yan, there was yet no court command; thereupon sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to present victory at the capital, concurrently stating the intent of provisional authority, and requesting a great campaign to pacify the Central Plain.
repairs.after: Although Huang styled himself King of Yan, there was yet no court mandate; he thereupon sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to report his victory at the capital, also explaining his provisional assumption of authority and requesting a great campaign to pacify the Central Plain.
repairs.sourceQuote: 皝雖稱燕王，未有朝命，乃遣其長史劉祥獻捷京師，兼言權假之意，並請大舉討平中原。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Though he called himself king of Yan, the court had not recognized it, so he sent Liu Xiang to report victories, explain his provisional rule, and ask for a northern expedition.
repairs.reason: Keeps 長史, 獻捷京師, 兼言權假之意 and 大舉討平中原; adds the needed reflexive for 稱燕王 without adding content.

repairs.before: Though he called himself king of Yan, the court had not recognized it, so he sent Liu Xiang to report victories, explain his provisional rule, and ask for a northern expedition.
repairs.after: Though he called himself King of Yan, he still lacked a court mandate, so he sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to report his victory at the capital, explain his provisional assumption of authority, and ask for a major campaign to pacify the Central Plain.
repairs.sourceQuote: 皝雖稱燕王，未有朝命，乃遣其長史劉祥獻捷京師，兼言權假之意，並請大舉討平中原。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Although Huang styled King of Yan, there was yet no court command; thereupon sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to present victory at the capital, concurrently stating the intent of provisional authority, and requesting a great campaign to pacify the Central Plain.
repairs.reason: Restores 長史, 京師 and 討平中原 (not merely a northern expedition); 未有朝命 as lacking a court mandate is accurate.

repairs.before: Ke rode victory to pursue them, beheaded and captured over thirty thousand grades, built a fort at Fancheng and returned.
repairs.after: Ke, riding the victory, pursued them, beheaded and captured over thirty thousand heads, built a garrison at Fancheng and returned.
repairs.sourceQuote: 恪乘勝追之，斬獲三萬餘級，築戍凡城而還。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Murong Ke pursued, killed or captured thirty thousand, and fortified Fancheng on the withdrawal.
repairs.reason: 斬獲三萬餘級 kept as over thirty thousand, 乘勝 and 築戍凡城而還 rendered accurately as a garrison then return.

repairs.before: Murong Ke pursued, killed or captured thirty thousand, and fortified Fancheng on the withdrawal.
repairs.after: Murong Ke pressed the victory in pursuit, killed or captured over thirty thousand, built a garrison at Fancheng, and returned.
repairs.sourceQuote: 恪乘勝追之，斬獲三萬餘級，築戍凡城而還。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Ke rode victory to pursue them, beheaded and captured over thirty thousand grades, built a fort at Fancheng and returned.
repairs.reason: Restores 乘勝 and 餘 in 三萬餘級, and 築戍凡城而還 as building a garrison and returning rather than fortifying on withdrawal.

repairs.before: Yu Bing, terrified yet unable to coerce him from afar, joined He Chong in recommending that the court recognize the title of king of Yan.
repairs.after: On seeing the memorial and the letter, Yu Bing was greatly alarmed; because Huang was so far away and beyond his power to control, he joined He Chong and others in memorializing that Huang be allowed to style himself King of Yan.
repairs.sourceQuote: 冰見表及書甚懼，以其絕遠，非所能制，遂與何充等奏聽皝稱燕王。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Bing seeing the memorial and letter was greatly afraid; because they were extremely distant, not what they could control; thereupon with He Chong and others memorialized to permit Huang to style King of Yan.
repairs.reason: Restores 見表及書 and 等 in 與何充等奏聽皝稱燕王; 以其絕遠，非所能制 rendered faithfully.

repairs.before: Thereupon led cavalry twenty thousand out Wengong Pass, long drove reaching Ji city, advanced crossed Wusui Ford, entered Gaoyang; wherever passed burned granaries, plundered and moved You and Ji over thirty thousand households.
repairs.after: Thereupon he led twenty thousand cavalry out through Yeweng Pass, drove straight to Ji city, advanced across Wusui Ford, and entered Gaoyang; wherever he passed he burned the stores, and he plundered and relocated more than thirty thousand households from You and Ji.
repairs.sourceQuote: 於是率騎二萬出蠮螉塞，長驅至於薊城，進渡武遂津，入于高陽，所過焚燒積聚，掠徙幽、冀三萬餘戶。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: He led twenty thousand horse through Wengong Pass, raced to Ji, crossed Wusui Ford into Gaoyang, burned depots, and carried off thirty thousand households from You and Ji.
repairs.reason: 蠮螉 read ye1 wēng per cited character databases, so Yeweng Pass; keeps 長驅, 武遂津, 焚燒積聚 and 三萬餘戶.

repairs.before: He led twenty thousand horse through Wengong Pass, raced to Ji, crossed Wusui Ford into Gaoyang, burned depots, and carried off thirty thousand households from You and Ji.
repairs.after: He then led twenty thousand cavalry out through Yeweng Pass, drove straight to Ji city, advanced across Wusui Ford into Gaoyang, burning the stores wherever he passed, and carried off more than thirty thousand households from You and Ji.
repairs.sourceQuote: 於是率騎二萬出蠮螉塞，長驅至於薊城，進渡武遂津，入于高陽，所過焚燒積聚，掠徙幽、冀三萬餘戶。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Thereupon led cavalry twenty thousand out Wengong Pass, long drove reaching Ji city, advanced crossed Wusui Ford, entered Gaoyang; wherever passed burned granaries, plundered and moved You and Ji over thirty thousand households.
repairs.reason: Uses Yeweng for 蠮螉塞 consistent with paired literal, restores 餘 in 三萬餘戶 and 薊城; worker 'Yiweng' in the reason is not adopted in the text.

repairs.before: Murong Han shattered his army and took nearly every man alive.
repairs.after: He sent Murong Han with cavalry to strike them; Moqian Hun was badly defeated and escaped alone, while his entire host was taken captive.
repairs.sourceQuote: 遣翰率騎擊之，渾大敗，僅以身免，盡俘其眾。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Sent Han leading cavalry to strike them; Hun was greatly defeated, barely himself escaped, wholly captured their host.
repairs.reason: Restores 遣翰率騎擊之 and 僅以身免; 盡俘其眾 as entire host captured; Moqian Hun matches s0100 idiomatic.

repairs.before: Duan Juan, Xianbei chieftain and Jin general, sought him eagerly.
repairs.after: At that time the Xianbei shanyu Duan Juan, who held the Jin titles of General of Agile Cavalry and Duke of Liaoxi, had a refined fondness for men of talent and humbly invited Yang Yu.
repairs.sourceQuote: 時鮮卑單于段眷為晉驃騎大將軍、遼西公，雅好人物，虛心延裕。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: At the time Xianbei Shanyu Duan Juan was Jin’s General of Agile Cavalry and Duke of Liaoxi; by nature he loved men of talent and humbly invited Yu.
repairs.reason: 單于 should be romanized shanyu to match the paired literal and s0029 usage (大單于 great shanyu); otherwise 驃騎大將軍、遼西公、雅好人物、虛心延裕 are all restored.

repairs.before: When Duan Liao asked Shi Hu for an escort, Yang Yu served as chief clerk under Ma Qiu.
repairs.after: When Duan Liao asked Shi Hu to send troops to receive him, Yang Yu, while serving as Left Assistant, concurrently served as marshal to Ma Qiu, General Who Campaigns in the East.
repairs.sourceQuote: 段遼之請迎于季龍也，裕以左丞領征東麻秋司馬。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: At the time of Duan Liao’s request to welcome from Jilong, Yu as left assistant concurrently led Eastern Campaign Ma Qiu’s major.
repairs.reason: 司馬 is marshal not chief clerk; restores 以左丞領 and the title 征東 for Ma Qiu, consistent with s0071 司馬 = marshal.

repairs.before: At the time of Duan Liao’s request to welcome from Jilong, Yu as left assistant concurrently led Eastern Campaign Ma Qiu’s major.
repairs.after: When Duan Liao requested that Jilong receive him, Yu, as Left Assistant, concurrently served as marshal to Ma Qiu, General Who Campaigns in the East.
repairs.sourceQuote: 段遼之請迎于季龍也，裕以左丞領征東麻秋司馬。
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: When Duan Liao asked Shi Hu for an escort, Yang Yu served as chief clerk under Ma Qiu.
repairs.reason: 段遼之請迎于季龍 means Duan Liao asked Jilong to receive him; 以左丞領征東麻秋司馬 is a concurrent marshal post under the General Who Campaigns in the East.

repairs.before: Even a county post can bless one’s heirs—let alone chancellor.
repairs.after: Shaoyou said that a post as commandery clerk was enough to shelter one's descendants; how much more the post of chancellor of a state!
repairs.sourceQuote: 少遊有雲，郡掾足以廕後，況國相乎！
repairs.pairedFieldChecked: Shao You said, a commandery aide suffices to shade posterity—how much more a state chancellor!
repairs.reason: Restores the speaker 少遊 and renders 郡掾 as commandery clerk and 國相 as state chancellor; 廕後 as sheltering descendants is accurate.
